steps.name: reserve
steps.sql: UPDATE accounts SET balance_cents = balance_cents - 5000 WHERE account_id = 'acct:1001';
steps.compensate_sql: UPDATE accounts SET balance_cents = balance_cents + 5000 WHERE account_id = 'acct:1001';

steps.name: credit_counterparty
steps.sql: UPDATE accounts SET balance_cents = balance_cents + 5000 WHERE account_id = 'acct:2002';
steps.compensate_sql: UPDATE accounts SET balance_cents = balance_cents - 5000 WHERE account_id = 'acct:2002';
